name: Yoshikiri Tooka
source:
"Is having a conversation with [url=/c113574]Fukami-kun[/url] worth more than 2 math questions?"

Likes: City topics, city fashion

Kyouhei's classmate, a second-year student, and an honor student who is studying hard to become a doctor.

A girl with a model-like figure and an immensely beautiful face, she thinks that she can't waste a single second of her study time in order to leave the small island and become a doctor in the city. Because of this, she decides that having a conversation or interacting with the people of the same age are pointless, building a wall around her.

Basically, she is a calm, collected, clear-headed, cool, and beautiful girl. However, since her longing for the city is so strong, when topics about the city are brought up, she becomes useless......

As a reaction to her living a life that always feels stressed, she dresses openly when she is at her house to relieve it. In other words, she gets naked.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/samenana/character/toka.html]Official website[/url]]
